blocks.en: # Migrate Callers Then Delete Legacy APIs
blocks.zh: # 迁移调用方后删除旧 API

blocks.en: - Update tests to assert the new contract, and delete tests that only protect pre-refactor implementation details
blocks.zh: - 更新测试以断言新合同，删除仅保护重构前实现细节的测试。

blocks.en:
**When this applies:**
- No external users depend on backward compatibility
- The project can absorb coordinated breaking changes
- The new API is part of a simplification or refactor initiative
blocks.zh:
**适用条件：**
- 没有外部用户依赖向后兼容。
- 项目能接受协调一致的破坏性变更。
- 新 API 属于简化或重构工作。
